Tiếp theo, các đầu bếp tiến hành sơ chế rau gia vị, trộn đều thịt băm, tôm, chả sống, trứng cùng bột và gia vị trong tô. summary_en: This cooking tutorial video begins with a showcase of fresh ingredients and a conversation between two chefs. They proceed to prep herbs, mix minced meat, shrimp, raw sausage, eggs, flour, and seasonings in a bowl. The mixture is then deep-fried in hot oil, paired with a custom dipping sauce, plated, and presented as the final dish.
